name: SharedFunctions
description: Documentation for native functions that nanos world does not document in any class.

functions.name: CallEvent
functions.description: Calls a custom event on this entity, received by Subscribe of this entity

functions.name: GetAssetName
functions.description: Gets the asset path the entity was spawned with

functions.name: GetBoneTransform
functions.description: Gets the world transform of a bone, a table with location and rotation

return.description: The transform with location and rotation

functions.name: GetInitialLocation
functions.description: Gets the location the entity was spawned at

functions.name: GetVOIPChannel
functions.description: Gets the voice channel of the Player

functions.name: GetVOIPSetting
functions.description: Gets the voice setting of the Player

functions.name: IsGrabbable
functions.description: Gets whether Characters can grab the Prop

functions.name: IsMovementEnabled
functions.description: Gets whether the Character can move

functions.name: RecreatePhysics
functions.description: Recreates the physics state of the vehicle

functions.name: SetGrabbable
functions.description: Sets whether Characters can grab the Prop

functions.name: SetInitialLocation
functions.description: Sets the location the entity returns to, for example when it falls out of the world

functions.name: SetMovementEnabled
functions.description: Enables or disables the movement of the Character

functions.name: SetRadius
functions.description: Sets the radius of a sphere Trigger

functions.name: SetVOIPChannel
functions.description: Sets the voice channel of the Player

functions.name: SetVOIPSetting
functions.description: Sets the voice setting of the Player

functions.name: SetVOIPVolume
functions.description: Sets the voice volume of the Player
